apk.notes: Settings → Delete My Account. A shop's only owner can save a copy of its inventory and transactions first (install this version of the app for that).

web.notes: Deckbox: Save Last Comps keeps each item's Comp with the date, and it fills Market Price when the item is sold; a green note on the item shows it. Price tags print on their own 7/8 x 15/16" labels, and the app says when the other roll is in.

desktop.notes: Price tags print now: DYMO Connect turned down the price tag label before ("Invalid label file").
